description: Open a privacy-shielded buyer concierge thread ('Verified Buyer #XXXX via DealerDirect Concierge') with a dealership WITHOUT exposing the buyer's personal email or phone number. Sends an ADF/XML + plain-text checklist and a 15-second zero-login Dealer Deal-Desk magic link to verify physical lot availability, keys, smoke-free condition, mandatory add-ons, and an itemized Out-The-Door (OTD) quote for the buyer's registration ZIP.

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's 5-digit US registration ZIP code (e.g., '33131') for accurate tax, title, tag, and OTD calculation.

financing_type.description: Buyer's planned payment or financing method (default: 'undecided').

questions.description: Optional custom verification questions for the sales manager (for classics, defaults automatically include cold-start video, undercarriage rust check, numbers-matching stampings, and enclosed shipping quote).

request_cold_start_video.description: Classic/collector option: explicitly request a cold-start & idle walkaround video.

request_enclosed_shipping_quote.description: Classic/collector option: request an insured enclosed-carrier shipping quote to buyer_zip.

request_numbers_matching_check.description: Classic/collector option: request engine block/VIN stamping numbers-matching verification.

request_undercarriage_photos.description: Classic/collector option: request lift/undercarriage frame & floorpan rust verification.

target_otd_usd.description: Optional opening firm Out-The-Door target offer in whole USD.

trade_in_summary.description: Optional trade-in summary if applicable (e.g., '2019 Honda Accord EX-L, 54k miles, clean title').

vehicle_id.description: Canonical vehicle ID or 17-character VIN to verify and quote.

name: start_shielded_inquiry
title: Start Shielded Proxy Concierge Inquiry (Verify Lot Status & Request OTD)
